repo_model.summary: This repository is a RelBench Formula 1 position-regression candidate. main.py now performs temporally causal feature construction, shared rolling feature caching, LightGBM/CatBoost ensemble prediction, validation output, and train-plus-validation test refitting. The registered full rolling evaluation completed 56 invocations with validation MAE 2.681566 over 499 rows.

entrypoints.how_to_run: From the repository root, run `python main.py --debug` for reduced model iterations or `python main.py` for the full candidate path; the evaluator supplies RELBENCH_DATASET, RELBENCH_TASK, and KAPSO_RUN_DATA_DIR.

evidence.description: Reads the output directory environment variable.

entrypoints.how_to_run: Use the registered `kapso_evaluation/kapso_eval.py` entrypoint for fast or full rolling evaluation.

evidence.description: Identifies the registered entrypoint and its per-tick execution.

entrypoints.how_to_run: The direct grader CLI supports `python kapso_evaluation/grader.py --fidelity fast` or `--fidelity full`, with optional `--fraction F` and `--seed S`.

where_to_edit.role: Candidate orchestration: task loading, rolling detection, cache selection, validation prediction, train-plus-validation refit, output writing, and diagnostics.
F1-specific temporal feature engineering, shared cache resolution, baseline diagnostics, LightGBM/CatBoost fitting, blending, correction, and clipping.
Reusable RelBench loader, prediction saver, temporal-safety guard, and MAP@K utility.
Evaluation contract reference for output files, shapes, dtypes, data access, and validation safety.
Immutable scoring and isolation pipeline; do not modify as part of candidate solution work.

claims.statement: main.py is the candidate orchestrator: it reads the RelBench dataset and task from environment variables, loads them without downloading, obtains train/validation/test tables and the database, builds features, fits predictions, and writes outputs under KAPSO_RUN_DATA_DIR.

evidence.description: Defines the dataset and task loading helper.
Loads task data and database before feature construction.
Fits the model and predicts the test rows.

claims.statement: FeatureBuilder owns the F1 feature pipeline: it snapshots database tables and prepares entities, results, task labels, standings, qualifying data, and races; its history slicing selects observations at or before each seed timestamp.

evidence.description: Uses timestamp-bounded search to select historical rows.
Copies all database tables into the builder.
Requires features to use records dated at or before each seed time.

claims.statement: Rolling invocations use a shared parquet feature cache keyed by seed date and driver ID. Missing rows are built by FeatureBuilder, appended to the cache, and committed through a temporary file plus atomic replacement.

evidence.description: Uses the fixed shared cache filename.
Constructs cache keys from date and driver ID.
Checks which requested rows are already cached.
Creates a process-specific temporary parquet path.
Enables cached features only for rolling runs.
Records the temporally censored shared cache artifact.

claims.statement: fit_predict compacts the feature set, trains a cohort-centered LightGBM regressor and a CatBoost MAE regressor, blends them 70/30, applies a within-seed cohort correction, clips predictions, and returns diagnostic component predictions.

evidence.description: Fits LightGBM to targets centered on cohort position.
Blends LightGBM and CatBoost predictions at 70/30.
Groups predictions by seed year and day of year.
Clips predictions to the allowed range.

claims.statement: Ordinary runs first fit on training rows to generate validation predictions, then refit on train plus validation labels to produce the final test predictions; rolling runs skip validation output and predict only the current test snapshot.

evidence.description: Identifies rolling mode from an empty validation table.
Branches ordinary-run validation and refit logic.
Predicts validation rows from training-only features.
Combines train and validation rows for refitting.
Refits the ensemble on the combined data.
Overwrites test_predictions.npy with the refit prediction.

claims.statement: The protected grader is the scoring boundary: it runs main.py in isolation, validates outputs, evaluates official RelBench validation metrics, and assembles per-tick rolling predictions in official row order.

evidence.description: Documents isolated candidate execution and official validation scoring.
Starts the candidate as a child subprocess.

claims.statement: Every ordinary candidate run must produce both val_predictions.npy and test_predictions.npy, with rows positionally aligned to the corresponding RelBench validation and test tables; validation predictions must be out-of-sample and must not be trained on validation labels.

evidence.description: Requires both prediction files after every run.
Requires validation predictions to be out-of-sample.
Restricts use of validation labels in training.
Generates validation predictions before validation labels are added to the refit.

claims.statement: Non-recommendation predictions must be finite float vectors of shape (N,), with multiclass predictions using shape (N, C); binary predictions must be probabilities in the inclusive range [0, 1].

evidence.description: Defines binary, regression, and multiclass output formats.

claims.statement: Recommendation predictions must be integer arrays of shape (N, K), containing ranked destination IDs that are distinct within each row and lie in [0, num_dst).

evidence.description: Defines recommendation shape, dtype, ranking, uniqueness, and ID range.
Detects duplicate destination IDs per row.

claims.statement: The search score of record is the configured official validation primary metric; test labels and test metrics are unavailable inside this workspace.

evidence.description: Defines the official validation primary metric as the search score.
States that test metrics are private.
States that test labels are physically absent.
Places the selected primary validation metric in the manifest score.

claims.statement: For this F1 rolling task, the official score of record is validation MAE over all 499 validation rows, where lower is better; R2 and RMSE are reporting metrics only.

evidence.description: Defines validation MAE as the score of record and states that all validation rows are scored.
Reports the final MAE, R2, and RMSE over 499 rows.

claims.statement: RelBench data access must use the sanitized read-only cache with download=False, and candidate code must not probe for test labels.

evidence.description: Requires RelBench API access with download=False.
Forbids probing for absent test labels.
Documents loading from the sanitized cache.

claims.statement: The F1 model writes float64 NumPy predictions and clips each prediction to at least 1 and at most max(18, recent field-size mean plus 2).

evidence.description: Clips predictions to the lower and dynamic upper bounds.

claims.statement: Rolling snapshots are evaluated causally: each invocation receives a tick-truncated database, already-closed training label windows, an empty validation table, and the current tick as test data.

evidence.description: Defines the per-tick input snapshot and closed-label training window.
Requires feature records to be dated at or before each seed time.
Bounds temporal history selection by the seed timestamp.

claims.statement: After writing predictions, run `python kapso_datasets/check_predictions.py` to verify required files, row counts, shapes, dtypes, finiteness, and binary probability bounds before official scoring.

evidence.description: Recommends the prediction checker for pre-validation.
Checks both validation and test splits.

claims.statement: Use the grader's fast fidelity mode as the end-to-end dry run; it invokes the candidate with --debug while still scoring the complete official validation split.

evidence.description: Documents delegation to the grader CLI.
States that fast mode still scores the complete validation split.
Confirms that both fast and full fidelity score every validation row.

claims.statement: A successful official evaluation prints validation metrics and a machine-readable KAPSO_EVAL_MANIFEST whose score is the configured primary metric.

evidence.description: Sets the manifest score to the primary validation metric.

claims.statement: The frozen registered full run completed all 56 rolling invocations and achieved validation R2 0.436914, MAE 2.681566, and RMSE 3.478866 over 499 rows.

evidence.description: Records the completed 56-invocation run and official metrics.

claims.statement: main.py identifies rolling mode solely from len(val) == 0. In rolling debug runs it restricts training to the most recent 20 years, enables the shared cache, emits only current test predictions, and skips val_predictions.npy.

evidence.description: Determines rolling mode from an empty validation table.
Limits rolling debug training to a 20-year window.
Enables cached features according to rolling mode.
Always writes the current test predictions.
Guards validation output and refitting behind non-rolling mode.

claims.statement: main.py explicitly requests get_db(upto_test_timestamp=False), but rolling evaluation remains safe because the protected evaluator supplies a database snapshot truncated at the current tick and the feature builder enforces seed-time history cutoffs.

evidence.description: Requests the database without the default test-timestamp cutoff.
States that every rolling invocation receives a tick-truncated database.
Selects only history through the requested timestamp.

claims.statement: The cache path defaults to output_data_generic_exp_0 unless KAPSO_SHARED_CACHE_DIR is set, and the fixed cache key is lane0_driver_position_temporal_rank_v3; stale or incompatible files at that location can affect rolling feature resolution.

evidence.description: Defines the shared-cache environment variable and default directory.
Defines the fixed feature cache key.
Builds the cache path from the fixed key.
Fails if requested rows cannot be resolved from the cache.

claims.statement: Debug and full inference use materially different iteration counts: LightGBM uses 80 versus 420 estimators and CatBoost uses 80 versus 240, so debug scores are a speed preflight rather than a final-fidelity estimate.

evidence.description: Selects LightGBM iteration counts by debug mode.
Selects CatBoost iteration counts by debug mode.

claims.statement: For autocomplete tasks, load_task defaults to a database limited through the test timestamp; pass upto_test_timestamp=False when post-test-cutoff entity rows are needed as inputs because their targets are blanked.

evidence.description: Explains that post-cutoff targets are blanked inputs.

claims.statement: The prediction checker reports out-of-range recommendation IDs and duplicate IDs as warnings rather than failing immediately, even though the evaluation contract requires valid ranked destination IDs.

evidence.description: Prints a warning for out-of-range IDs.
Prints a warning for duplicate IDs.

claims.statement: The grader's fraction and seed arguments do not subsample validation rows: fast mode changes only the candidate invocation, while the complete official validation set remains scored.

evidence.description: Defines fast mode as the candidate debug build.
States that fast mode still scores the complete validation split.

claims.statement: The candidate runtime depends on RelBench dataset/task APIs, NumPy, pandas, and the local rel_f1_model module.

evidence.description: Imports the F1 feature and model functions.

claims.statement: Model fitting lazily requires CatBoost and LightGBM; OMP_NUM_THREADS controls both LightGBM and CatBoost thread counts.
Evaluation supplies RELBENCH_DATASET, RELBENCH_TASK, and KAPSO_RUN_DATA_DIR; rolling feature reuse additionally uses KAPSO_SHARED_CACHE_DIR when configured.

evidence.description: Reads KAPSO_SHARED_CACHE_DIR with a default fallback.

claims.statement: The selected model uses 358 compact features, a 70% cohort-centered LightGBM plus 30% MAE CatBoost ensemble, and a 20% cohort-mean correction; alternatives were rejected using training-only forward resampling.

evidence.description: Records the compact feature count, ensemble weights, selection method, and cohort correction.
Records the rejected model and feature variants.

claims.statement: The critical path is cached per-origin feature resolution: cache lookup takes about 3 seconds and a full candidate tick takes about 10.1-11.2 seconds, within the shared full-run budget.

evidence.description: Records measured candidate seconds and the revised target.
Records cache resolution and full tick timings.

claims.statement: The sanctioned data contains 7,453 training rows across 254 origins, 499 validation rows across 23 origins, and 760 test rows across 33 origins; origin gaps are usually 60 days but can be irregular.

evidence.description: Reports normal and irregular origin gaps.

claims.statement: Post-hoc diagnostics identify preseason months 1-3 as the largest loss regime, with MAE 3.5582 versus 2.3087 for midseason months 4-8; the dominant limitation is missing upcoming-season qualifying and race evidence.

Feature development should cover driver, constructor, standing, qualifying, race, calendar, closed-label, and within-cohort signals while avoiding future-circuit joins that are unavailable in legal snapshots.

evidence.description: Records the implemented causal feature families.
Lists time and regulation coverage axes.
Explains why future circuit joins are unknowable.
